cohort: Gauquelin A1 sports champions, commit-pinned g5 A1.csv
candidate_generation: Q5 humans with day-precision P569 exactly equal to A1 birth date.
Only if unresolved, Q5 humans with day-precision P569 +/-1 day.
name_rules: SUBSET_TOKEN_MATCH with >=2 shared tokens and >=2/3 smaller/larger token coverage
place_tiebreak: Use P19 label or P625 only to break a tied top name/date rank.
Place text match or <=50 km coordinate match qualifies.
Never allow place alone to create a link.
ranking: tied highest rank may resolve only by unique place match
uniformity_rule: Apply to all 2087 A1 records. Do not load prediction labels/status during linkage.
cross_cohort_rule: A1/A2 duplicate identities, if any, must be removed after both linkages are frozen and before any combined efficacy unblind, using only identity evidence/QIDs and birth data.
